cs.t: I use a Husky adjustable workbench paired with a Grovemade monitor stand and I like it. I’ve been using the setup for a few months now. I removed my chair from my office entirely, so I stand for most of the day. I do have a small bench in my office that I sit on when my feet get tired or when I need to think (the thinking bench is away from the desk). And my feet do get tired/sore some days; I wear shoes to help alleviate that. Overall, I like it. I feel better standing all day, and have less upper back pain. The Husky workbench is pretty affordable compared to a “standing desk.”
